correctness.rationale: The recurrence follows exactly from the complement gap decomposition, independent two-cut threshold child and the standard minimax identity for shattered binary trees; all quantifiers include every n >= 1. The VC claim and two-logarithm asymptotic have separate proofs. Exact ranks through n=40 are computed by partition DP and independently by definition-level bitset recurrence, and the critical n=6 case has an explicit depth-four witness and a symmetry-based depth-five obstruction. No finite experiment substitutes for the all-n proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural finite circular-convexity concept class, with an exact rank algorithm based on integer partitions rather than arbitrary hypothesis version spaces; it determines the first ten depth thresholds and locates the earliest loss of the sharp hypothesis-cardinality limit. Its VC dimension is fixed at three while the exact online rank grows with leading coefficient two on the logarithmic scale. These features motivate the exact invariant independently of arbitrary cutoffs or code reproducibility.
